messages:
maya: Quick watercooler idea — should our onboarding have a mascot voiced by an LLM? Vote with emoji. Options: Redwood-1 (deep & calm), TinyMoss (tiny chipmunk energy), Llama Lite (perky). :speaker:

ben: Redwood-1. sounds like a trustworthy runtime. :thumbsup:

devon: TinyMoss for memery. it yells about quantization mid-sentence. :joy:

amanda: Llama Lite for docs walkthroughs, Redwood-1 for enterprise videos. split personalities ftw. :split:

ops-bot: Poll started b0 React :one: Redwood-1, :two: TinyMoss, :three: Llama Lite. Poll ends in 24h.

maya: I sketched a short prompt for "Redwood Randy":
```
You are Redwood Randy, a helpful inference server with barista vibes.
Tone: calm, slightly amused.
Length: <= 25 seconds spoken.
Include: one joke about batch sizes and a friendly doc nudge.
End with: "See the docs for tuning your flow." 
```

ben: love the barista motif. imagine him sipping espresso while logging latency. :coffee:

devon: we should add a micro-skit where Randy argues with a load balancer puppet. "No, you can't route my tokens like that." :puppet:

amanda: I'll run a few TTS variants tonight (fem/masc/robotic) and post mp3s. happy to A/B in onboarding. :headphones:

maya: if anyone has a one-liner outro, drop it here. my draft: "Keep your prompts spicy, your cache warm." :mic:

ben: alternate outro: "Pin your model, not your hopes." :laughing:

devon: adding comedic option: "Batch size? More like snack size." :pretzel:

amanda: uploading TTS samples in #audio-drops later. will tag you all. :raised_hands:
